# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

qa_mask = completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop QA orders if any
if qa_mask.sum() > 0:

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()
